name: org_graph_editors
description: List who may change the whole Org Graph: the Org Graph editors an admin chose, and the tenant's admins, who always may. Each with a person id and name. Each editor also has since (the date it took effect), added_by (who made them one, or null when no one did) and already_held (true when they were an editor before Espalia recorded who gave it). Admins only.
